historical_failures.observation: Three SOURCE fixtures used drive-less POSIX paths, correctly rejected by native Windows absolute-path custody guard before the mocked RPC test. Use native absolute fixture paths; do not weaken runtime guards or skip tests. Exact-head replay required.

Genuine Windows vault/reorg regression reached newly mandatory getnetworkinfo version attestation, but its private legacy fixture whitelist lacked that read. Add only this identity read; preserve scanner read surface, write restrictions and all native Credential Manager/custody gates. Replay required.

Native Cocoa reached genuine send, confirmation and reorg, then second Prepare timed out at the lost-broadcast regression. Queued automation can race real Sync between idle check and button dispatch. Wait at dispatch and force the actual Core-worker overlap to qualify the repair; never disable timers or force-enable protected controls. Replay required.

Genuine Windows operational gate timed out while creating config/cookie Q02 fixture nodes, before scenario enumeration. Existing config-auth 101-block/BIP352/vault gates passed. Failing mode/cause not yet observed; add fixed-category boot diagnostics and create only the fresh owned cookie parent with existing strict native owner-only custody. No timeout increase or gate waiver; replay required.
